description: Labelled real exercise videos for rep-count evaluation. Files are not committed (except the small sample); run `python -m experiments.real_clips.fetch`.

schema.id: unique slug, also the landmark file name
schema.url: direct file URL (Wikimedia upload.wikimedia.org) or null when local_path is set
schema.local_path: repo-relative path for clips that ship with the repo
schema.license: SPDX-like short licence name; only clips that allow redistribution/derivatives are listed
schema.author: attribution string
schema.sha256: hash of the downloaded file; a mismatch means the upstream file changed
schema.segment: [start_s, end_s] analysed part of the video, or null for all
schema.view: camera view as seen by a human: side | front | rear-oblique | oblique
schema.gt_reps: ground-truth number of completed reps inside the segment
schema.fault_labels: optional per-rep fault labels (list of lists of fault codes), null if not labelled
schema.source_type: filmed (a person on camera) | rendered (3D-animated avatar)
schema.conditions: anything that makes the clip harder or non-standard

clips.author: FitnessScape (re-encoded and looped once, see samples/ATTRIBUTION.md)
clips.gt_method: Counted by hand from a 2 fps contact sheet (ffmpeg fps=2,tile): bottoms at about 2.0, 5.0, 9.0 and 12.3 s, each followed by a return to standing.
